ctx.x: Mr. Blakeney reiterates sharp contrast in the recording procedures in the very beginning till now. Jazz is an immortal artform and these recordings will help preserve its history.

Continuing with the discography of Andrew Blakeney, 1979, June of 1979, the Legends of Jazz label recorded in Los Angeles. The personnel was as follows: Louis Nelson, trombone; Blakeney, trumpet; Sammy Lee, clarinet and vocals; Alton Purnell, piano and vocals; Adolphus Morris, bass; Barry Martyn, drums.

The songs that were recorded were "St. Louis Blues," "Oh, How I Miss You Tonight," "Dark Town Strutters Ball," "High Ho Silver," a vocal featuring Sammy Lee, the clarinetist. The last number was "It's Too Late Now." That concluded the session in June of 1979, Crescent Jazz Productions present the Legends of Jazz on the Legends of Jazz label.
